subject: Temporary spike-inspector tile + route economics playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ethan.lowe@acme.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary spike-inspector tile + route economics playbook

Team —

Quick ask coming out of Acme's outage this morning: they asked for an "at-a-glance" tile we can flip on in Console that shows, per-route, a short window (last 60m) view of: P50/P95/P99 latency, cost per 1k requests (rolling), and a small list of top token-heavy call samples. We need this to do two things:

- Give SRE/CS a fast triage view during customer spikes without opening full trace playback.
- Produce a concise set of actions (playbook) so CS can tell customers what we did and whether a canary fallback executed.

I'm attaching a small sample export from Acme's tenant and a quick wireframe. Can we scope a temporary (feature-flagged) tile that we can enable next week for 48h during the customer's weekend test run?

Constraints to keep in mind: should not increase token-level telemetry ingestion long-term — prefer sampler + aggregate metrics. If we can reuse existing metric ingestion (pathway counts + latency histograms) that's ideal.

Asks:
- Marcus: can infra surface a 1h rolling aggregation endpoint for route-level cost+latency by EOD Wed?
- Irene: can Observability propose a minimal UX and a playbook template for CS to use when the tile flags a spike?
- Marissa: loop in CS for wording and confirm escalation steps with Acme.

Thanks —
Tessa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: route-cost-sample.csv (csv), mock-spike-tile-wireframe.png (image)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 11:14:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary spike-inspector tile + route economics playbook

Tessa —

Thanks, got the attachments and the ask. Quick clarifying points:

1) Aggregation: we can expose a /internal/route-telemetry endpoint that returns 1m buckets with latency histograms and token counts. That will let the tile compute rolling P95/P99. We need to cap retention to 2 hours for the temporary flag to avoid storage churn.

2) Cost calc: cost per 1k requests depends on model variant; does Acme want model-level breakouts or a blended route-level number? Blended is cheaper to compute; model-level will add cardinality.

3) Sampling: to keep ingestion low we'll return top token-heavy samples by sampling request IDs with largest token_delta in the 1m windows. We'll return up to 5 examples per route.

I attached a quick example CSV built from current telemetry (route-cost-sample.csv) showing the fields we'd expose. If you want the prototype by next Tue, I can have an infra endpoint + small renderer in Console (feature-flag scoped to Acme) — depends on how fast we want the playbook.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Wed EOD: internal telemetry endpoint (2h retention) available in staging.
- Fri: first Console tile prototype behind FF.
- Mon (customer weekend): enable for Acme; run with CS and SRE nearby.

Tell me whether you want model-level cost split or blended.

— Marcus
Staff SWE, Inference Infrastructure

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 08:34:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary spike-inspector tile + route economics playbook

Tessa/Marcus —

We can own the UX + playbook template. Proposed minimal tile fields: route name, blended cost/1k (configurable to model-level), P50/P95/P99 over last 60m, current 1m delta percentage vs baseline, and up to 3 sampled call snippets with truncated user prompt and token count. Tile should link to: trace playback, tenant billing snapshot, and the canary fallback log.

I'll put together a 1-page playbook that has the triage checklist (isolate model variant, check KV cache pressure, confirm fallback executed, escalate to infra with timeline) and a customer-facing message template for CS. Draft links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1gSpikeInspectorPlan (editable) and JIRA-7892 for the quick work.

Timeline we can hit without heavy lift:
- Wed EOD (staging): accept Marcus's telemetry endpoint.
- Thu: Console renderer + playbook draft.
- Fri: internal smoke test; get CS to review message templates.

One note on retention: to preserve costs, the tile will render samples only for requests that are already in our small sample-store (we'll not keep full payloads beyond 48h for the FF).

I'll start the playbook doc and tag Marissa for CS inputs.

— Irene
Product Manager, Observability

Thanks — this looks good. Blended cost is fine for the quick run (we'll add model split if Acme requests). Please proceed with Marcus's proposed timeline.

Marissa, can you confirm CS can be on a tight review Wed-Fri? I'd like the playbook before the Fri smoke test.

Ethan — we will enable the tile for Acme in a feature flag and then run the test during your monitored window. CS will send pre- and post-run notes.

If anything changes, flag immediately in this thread so SRE can triage.

— Tessa
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
